import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { activeStorageVariantRecords } from "../../../backend/schema/active_storage_variant_records";

export const activeStorageVariantRecordsCms = customizeTable<typeof activeStorageVariantRecords>("active_storage_variant_records", {
    hideFromNavigation: true,
    display: {
        title: "variationDigest"
    },
    fields: {
        variationDigest: {
            multiline: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: ["id", "variationDigest", "blob"]
});
